name: Python + Poetry + GCloud Runner
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl apt-transport-https ca-certificates gnupg python3 python3-pip python3-venv && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] https://google.com cloud-sdk main" | sudo tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list && curl https://google.com/doc/apt-key.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y google-cloud-cli && curl -sSL https://python-poetry.org | python3 - && export PATH="/home/vscode/.local/bin:$PATH" && poetry install --no-root
